content.short: EcoCashew.com connects Cardano with fair-trade cashew processing, jobs, and lower carbon supply chains.
content.description: EcoCashew.com is an impact-focused project connected to fair-trade cashew production and local value creation in West Africa. Its mission is to move more of the cashew processing chain closer to producers, especially in Nigeria, so farmers can benefit from better prices and local jobs. The project frames Cardano as part of a transparency and coordination layer for sustainable commerce. EcoCashew.com focuses on fair trade, reduced carbon footprint, and improving farmer outcomes through better supply-chain design.
